title: Assessment of Communication Interventions on Vaccination Knowledge and Acceptance
official: Effectiveness Assessment of Communication Interventions to Improve Vaccination Knowledge and Acceptance
summary: An online randomized controlled trial (RCT) examining the effectiveness of communication measures regarding TBE vaccination in the European context and yellow fever vaccination in the South American context on an informed vaccination decision. Building on an exploratory qualitative focus group study conducted in 2024 with vaccine-hesitant individuals (Ethics Committee Approval Number EA1/119/24) and an exploratory quantitative study conducted in 2025 among the general population in Germany and Colombia (Ethics Committee Approval Number EA2/112/25), the communication measures were designed to improve education about vaccinations and to increase individual willingness to be vaccinated.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* German citizens
* Colombian citizens

Exclusion Criteria:

* Citizens of all other countries
